description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, full arch with per-layer residual_lut + untied Linear(D=384, V), 1.4768 @ 103M / 475 Mbits). TWO coupled changes: E 96 -> 192 AND d_v 16 -> 32. Preserves H*d_v=E invariant (6*32=192) so out_proj stays square (192 -> 192, no compression). D stays at 384 (head architecture unchanged). All else identical to exp567 — same residual_lut per-layer NAP=6 tph=128 E->D=384, same Linear(D, V) head. Tests whether E-widening on the PROVEN full-arch recipe (no minimal-arch stripping, no dual-head dilution from exp582/583/584) gives a clean win over exp567. Predicted +52.7M params (tok_emb +3.15, v_lut +11.80, out_proj +37.74) -> ~156M total. Predicted +24 Mbits trunk -> 96 Mbits trunk (still 3.5x cheaper than vanilla's 340), total ~499 Mbits/tok. If exp585 < 1.4768, the E-widening compounds with full arch as expected. Refs: exp567 1.4768 (parent), exp575 ~1.54 (E=192 minimal arch), exp582 ~1.53 (dual TIED), exp583 1.5200 (dual TIED per-layer), exp584 1.4795 (dual UNTIED at E=96), exp328 1.3882 (tied vanilla).
